install_ai4animation_package: install the ai4animation Python package with pip using setup.py and all required dependencies
run_convert_console_script: run the convert console script to batch convert animation assets via ai4animation Import BatchConverter
build_ai4animation_wheel: build a wheel distribution of the ai4animation package using python setup.py bdist_wheel
review_setup_dependencies: review the setup.py install_requires to audit torch raylib numpy and other dependency versions
summarize_setup_config: summarize the setup.py configuration including package name version entry points and python version requirements
